# zettai.github.io: Copilot instructions

See **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** for what this repo is, how to set it up, the
commands, and the conventions. That file is the source of truth and is read by
every agent tool used here.

Keep this file thin. Only Copilot specifics belong below: MCP servers in
`.vscode/mcp.json` (`servers` key, not `mcpServers`), path-scoped rules under
`.github/instructions/`. Anything that would be true for another agent belongs
in AGENTS.md instead.
